title: Escape from the Injection

coreLoop: tap left/right screen regions or swipe to change lanes
maintain readable distance from the chaser
show clear caught/game-over and replay states
fairness: lane changes must be deterministic and responsive
obstacles must leave at least one viable lane
difficulty escalation must preserve a reaction window
game-over text must not obscure the replay action

reviewFocus: Prioritize non-graphic, child-appropriate presentation; keep the syringe hazard readable without frightening imagery.
Check that three lanes and tap/swipe controls are obvious and reliable.
Evaluate whether obstacles, stars, and the chaser create meaningful risk/reward rather than unavoidable hits.
Inspect changing locations, speed escalation, feedback, and replay affordance.
